description: Faithful SHOC Sort: the original CUDPP 4-bit radix sort (radixSortBlocks, findRadixOffsets, scan, vectorAddUniform4, reorderData) sorting 32-bit unsigned keys in 8 radix passes. Emits per-pass, per-kernel GPU times; sort rate is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: size
scaling_param.description: Number of key/value pairs to sort (must be a multiple of 1024)

non_scaling_params.name: precision
non_scaling_params.description: Key data-type label (keys are always sorted as 32-bit unsigned)

non_scaling_params.name: sort_block_size
non_scaling_params.description: radixSortBlocks CTA size (compile-time fixed, SHOC SORT_BLOCK_SIZE)

non_scaling_params.name: scan_block_size
non_scaling_params.description: findRadixOffsets/scan/reorderData CTA size (compile-time fixed, SHOC SCAN_BLOCK_SIZE)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
